description: This file defines a MatchRepository class that interacts with a MatchService to fetch match items based on filter preferences. It serves as an abstraction layer for retrieving match data in a dating app front-end project.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository class that orchestrates fetching matches based on user filter preferences.

methods.name: fetchMatches
methods.description: Fetches a list of match items asynchronously based on provided filter preferences.
